data.name: Quichotte’s Never-Ending Watch - A Lofi Companion
data.detailed_description:
Meet Sir Quichotte, your loyal desktop guardian! Watch this brave knight battle monsters while you work, study, or relax. Features Lofi music, timers, memos, task tracking, and cozy idle gameplay that lives right on your desktop.

Your Desktop's Most Charming Guardian Awaits!

Transform your workspace into a medieval realm with Sir Quichotte, the idle game that perfectly blends productivity with cozy entertainment. This isn't just another idle game—it's your personal desktop companion with a delightfully quirky personality who makes every workday more entertaining with his witty commentary and encouraging productivity puns.

🏰 Your Knight in Action

Sir Quichotte tirelessly patrols his kingdom, defending against zombies, skeletons, and mysterious creatures. But he's not your typical silent hero—this chatty knight has a wonderfully weird sense of humor! Expect delightful commentary, quirky observations, and encouraging productivity puns as he levels up, collects loot, and grows stronger. Pure, relaxing automation with personality.

🎯 Complete Productivity Suite

Advanced Timer System: Pomodoro, stopwatch, and countdown timers with daily session tracking and calendar integration.

Smart Memo System: Organize your thoughts across General, Work, Personal, and custom categories. Rich text support keeps all your notes beautifully formatted.

To-Do Lists: Create and manage tasks across multiple categories with checkbox completion tracking. Keep your quests organized both in-game and in real life!

Task & Session Tracking: Monitor your productivity goals and celebrate your daily achievements.

✨ Magic Spell System

Take control of your experience with powerful spells:

  • Enemy Filter Spells: Block specific monster types (zombies, skeletons, butchers)

  • Create Your Perfect Mode: Filter all enemies for peaceful patrols, or face full combat challenges

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Switch between action and tranquility as your mood changes

🎵 Seamless Desktop Integration

Integrated Lofi Playlist: Carefully curated background music to enhance focus

🌟 Key Features Summary

  • Chatty Knight Companion with weird humor and encouraging commentary

  • True Desktop Integration, use it as an island anywhere

  • Comprehensive Timer Suite with session tracking

  • Advanced Note-Taking with category organization

  • Flexible Combat Control via spell system

  • Cozy Hand-drawn Art in beautiful isometric style

  • Customizable Experience - adjust everything to your preference

Perfect For: Students seeking a comprehensive study companion • Remote workers wanting gentle background entertainment • Productivity enthusiasts who love gamified workflows • Anyone who enjoys cozy, customizable gaming • Fans of pixel art and medieval themes • People wanting both engaging combat and peaceful meditation modes

Make Sir Quichotte your desktop companion.
Your knight is ready to serve—are you ready to begin this charming adventure?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with at least 128 MB VRAM, supporting WebGL
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 at 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or AMD equivalent, 256 MB VRAM or more, DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: 64-bit Intel processor or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with at least 128 MB VRAM, supporting WebGL
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer, or Intel Core i5 (quad-core) or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with at least 256 MB VRAM (e.g., Intel Iris Plus, AMD Radeon, Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
